title: RentGuard Reinstatement Fee Tariff Addition for Late Charges
content:
The reinstatement fee on a RentGuard Renters Policy carries an addition for late charges posted on the policy in the last 12 calendar months.

| Late charges posted on the policy in the last 12 calendar months | Added to the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | 4.00 |
| exactly one | 2.00 |
| none | nothing |

**Charge.** When two or more late charges were posted on the policy in the last 12 calendar months, 4.00 is added to the fee; when exactly one was posted, 2.00 is added; when none was posted, nothing is added.

**Counting.** A late charge is a fee entry on the RentGuard premium account with fee code late fee. Each such entry posted within the last 12 calendar months counts once, whatever term it belongs to; one posted earlier than that does not count.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A hypothetical policy with late charges posted 2 months and 9 months ago has 4.00 added to the fee. If the earlier of the two had been posted 14 months ago, only one would count and 2.00 would be added. A policy with no late charge in the last 12 calendar months has nothing added.
